query: SELECT secret.id, secret.name AS "name: String", resource.created AS "created!: OffsetDateTime", secret.last_updated AS "last_updated: OffsetDateTime", COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM secret INNER JOIN RESOURCES_WITH_PERMISSION_FOR_LOGIN_ID($2, $3) AS resource ON secret.id = resource.id WHERE secret.workspace_id = $1 AND secret.deleted IS NULL AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR secret.name ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%') AND ($5::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR resource.created >= $5) AND ($6::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR resource.created <= $6) AND ($7::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR secret.last_updated >= $7) AND ($8::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR secret.last_updated <= $8) ORDER BY resource.created DESC LIMIT $9 OFFSET $10;
